author: Jim Moro
text: Zach came out on a weekend on an emergency call to take care of my septic that backed up a bit as it turned out the tank was pretty clean because I had had it pumped recently it ended up being blockage in the waste pipe leaving the house he was able to put his hose on the pipe and suck out the blockage everything is running excellent I can't say enough Zach was such a nice guy I've seen him before as I have been with Garside septic and sewer for a very very long time and obviously we'll continue to stay with them I am going to be scheduling some work with them based on a suggestion that Zach made on replacing a pipe thanks to everyone at garside including his father Keith and Sherry in the office.....Great business to contract with....

author: Cin Pani
text: We have been in this property for 3 years and have only had an amazing experience with Garside. They are dependable always available to answer my questions and whenever I call they come right out to the property within a week.

author: ralph autilio
text: Keith & Sherry are great .Sept will 26 years in NH and we have used Garside septic from day one and will never use anyone else . Thank you for the great service .

author: Stephen Punzak
text: What a great find!  Garside Septic is excellent.  Bought a house with a septic that hadn’t been pumped in years.  Called Garside and they were able to fit me in for the next week.  Not a huge company so the owner himself (40 years experience with septic tanks) was the one driving the truck and doing the service.  He took the time to explain how the tank was functioning and even was able to get special risers for the tank (same day) so it didn’t have to be dug up again.  Meticulous attention to detail.  Price was excellent too!  Highly recommend Garside!!

author: Steve Dwyer
text: Keith & Sherry were a pleasure to deal with. I had a septic issue and Keith came out to have a look. He opted for a less expensive repair that was much appreciated. Another company would have gladly taken my money. Keith & Garside Septic have integrity and I would highly recommend this company for any issues you may be having. Thanks again Keith & Sherry.
